before.name: The pair's own definition: Galilean limiting chart maps Phi_{v,C}, the Galilean boost G_v and bounded chart regions D_{T,R}
before.support: The coordinate expression of the framework's passive boost with a variable speed scale; the design's 'explicit Galilean limiting chart maps with bounded domains' is made a precise family of affine maps.

after.name: The pair's own definition: Galilean limiting chart maps Phi_{v,C}, the Galilean boost G_v and bounded chart regions D_{T,R}
after.support: The coordinate expression of the passive boost at C=c and an auxiliary variable-scale affine family for mathematical comparison. The definition uses fixed mathematical c>0 and x0=ct, with no physical SI item as a mathematical premise. The approved design's explicit Galilean limiting chart maps and bounded domains remain precise.

before.name: The pair's own lemma: uniform Galilean limit of the boost charts on bounded regions and its failure on unbounded regions
before.support: Proves the explicit bounds and the uniform C -> infinity limit on D_{T,R} from the pair's definition and the uniform Taylor remainder, with the unbounded-region failure displayed.

after.name: The pair's own lemma: uniform Galilean limit of the boost charts on bounded regions and its failure on unbounded regions
after.support: Local explicit projection inequality with |t|, fixed-z0 O(C^-2) constants from the Taylor remainder, an exact sufficient epsilon threshold |v|/sqrt(z1), and a separate v=0 identity case. Preserves uniform convergence on bounded D_(T,R), pointwise convergence and failure on the whole unbounded chart domain. No source is claimed to provide these exact quantitative constants.

before.name: The pair's own example: worked uniform Galilean chart bound
before.support: Explicit evaluation of the chart map and its bounds at C=10 and C=100 with the epsilon instance C=30.

after.name: The pair's own example: worked uniform Galilean chart bound
after.support: Exact radical evaluations at C=10,100,30, ratios computed before rounding, and an explicitly verified z0=1/4, z1=1/900 tolerance choice giving C_epsilon=max(30,sqrt(600))=30. All prior correct numerical conclusions are retained; the displayed threshold proof is completed without ellipsis.

before.name: Notions of distance: ruler distance versus radar distance, the null geodesic equation t - t_0 = log(x/x_0), the radar distance x_0 log(1 + h/x_0) and the caution that radar distance need not be symmetric

after.name: Notions of distance: ruler distance versus radar distance, the null geodesic equation t - t_0 = log(x/x_0), the radar distance x_0 log(1 + h/x_0) and the caution that radar distance need not be symmetric
after.support: The general radar distance rho_0 |log(rho_m/rho_0)| and the original worked radii 2rho_0 and rho_0/2 are retained.
